title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Create a new sequential unique GUID (Guid.CreateSequentialGuid Method)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces Guid.CreateSequentialGuid method which generates sequential unique GUIDs that perform better as table keys than random GUIDs. This method is useful when you need improved performance for GUID-based indexing.
key_points: Guid.CreateSequentialGuid creates sequential unique GUIDs instead of random ones
Sequential GUIDs perform better when used as table keys due to partial sequencing
The method is available in AL Language extension version 16.0
Each execution starts from a new GUID rather than continuing the sequence

quotes.text: Sequential GUIDs perform better when used as a field in a key, because they are partially sequential instead of fully random.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key benefit of the new method - improved performance for table key operations compared to random GUIDs
